metadata.description: Open-source AI marketing team for B2B SaaS — 75 agent personas, 19 skills, and the CATALYST orchestrator you install in Claude Code.

plugins.name: saas-marketing
plugins.description: 75 B2B SaaS marketing agent personas packaged as 19 installable skills plus the CATALYST orchestrator: content, SEO/AEO/GEO, paid media, social, email, design, sales enablement and technical presales, product marketing, pricing, account-based marketing (ABM), growth/PLG, analytics, comms and analyst relations, partnerships, events and field, developer marketing, project management, and client operations.
